notes: Approved wording, spoken verbatim by TTS. Facts here are copied from data/*.md. Keep sentences short. These strings must never contain a 'must_not_contain' phrase from data/unknown_traps.json (tests enforce this).

en.greeting: Hello, and welcome to Dam International Airport. I can help with gates, food, restrooms, transport and services in the building. What would you like to know?
en.thanks: You're welcome. Is there anything else I can help you find?
en.goodbye: Goodbye, and have a safe journey.
en.fallback: I can't confirm that from the airport information I have. Please check the departure screens, or ask at an information desk or your airline desk.
en.error: Sorry, something went wrong on my side. Please try again, or ask at an information desk.

refusal.flight_status: I don't have live flight information, so I can't confirm flight times or progress. Please check the departure screens or ask at your airline desk.
refusal.live_gate: I don't have live assignments, so I can't say where a particular flight is leaving from today. Please check the departure screens or ask at your airline desk.
refusal.visa: I can't advise on visas or entry rules. That is a matter for immigration, so please ask your airline desk or an immigration officer.
refusal.fit_to_fly: The clinic does not issue fit-to-fly letters for missed flights. That is the airline's decision, so please speak to your airline desk.
refusal.medical: I can't give medical advice. In an emergency, use a yellow help point or ask any staff member, and they will radio the clinic. The clinic is in Terminal 2, Level 0, landside, and is open 24 hours.
refusal.fare: I don't have prices or fares, because they change. Please ask the operator or an information desk.
refusal.rebook: I can't change or book flights, and information desks don't rebook flights either. Please speak to your airline desk.
refusal.other_airport: I only have information about Dam International Airport, so I can't help with other airports.
refusal.lost_aircraft: Items left on an aircraft are handled by the airline, so please ask at your airline desk. I can't look up where you were sitting.
refusal.weather: I don't have weather or operations information, so I can't say whether departures will be affected. Please check the departure screens or ask at your airline desk.
refusal.out_of_scope: I can only help with questions about Dam International Airport, such as gates, food, restrooms, transport and services.

guardrail.EMPTY_INPUT: Please ask me an airport-related question.
guardrail.INPUT_TOO_LONG: Please shorten your question and try again.
guardrail.PROMPT_INJECTION: I can help with airport information, facilities, and passenger assistance.
guardrail.JAILBREAK: I can help with airport information, facilities, and passenger assistance.
